failure_point: USER ACTION → CHAT INVOCATION. The click never reached the handler, so nothing after it was ever attempted.
root_cause: [data-lelu-signin-gate] mounts AFTER first paint at position:fixed; inset:0; z-index:600; pointer-events:auto. It covers the entire viewport, so real pointer clicks land on the modal instead of the home. A driver that samples for the gate immediately after DOMContentLoaded sees no gate (it is not mounted yet), concludes there is nothing to dismiss, and then clicks into a modal that appeared underneath it.

selectors.actual: Opening chat mounts the Chat Universe: [role=dialog][aria-label="Chat Universe"] with composer .lcu textarea. [data-lelu-chat-window] is the single-chat window and only exists once a conversation is opened as a module window (chat:<id>).
selectors.composer_marker: [data-lelu-composer] belongs to the single-chat composer, not the Universe composer
